title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With 30 offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at&nbsp;<a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><h2><strong>Über Verve Retail Media</strong></h2> <p>Das größte Problem im stationären Handel für Werbungtreibende ist der fehlende Wirkungsnachweis. Marken investieren Millionen in Werbung am Point of Sale, können aber nicht belegen, ob daraus Käufe generiert wurden.</p> <p>Verve Retail Media (VRM) löst dieses Problem. Wir vermarkten und betreiben digitale Werbe-Screens in mehreren tausend LEH-, Drogerie- und Convenience-Standorten und verbinden sie mit digitalen Coupons und Retargeting im CTV und anderen Offsite-Kanälen. Marken buchen keine isolierten Werbeformate, sondern 360-Grad-Kampagnen, die zu Hause starten und bis zum stationären Kauf gehen: Closed-Loop-Messung auf Basis realer Kassendaten.</p> <p>VRM ist die eigenständige Retail Media Unit der börsennotierten Verve Group SE. Wir arbeiten wie ein schnell skalierendes Startup mit einer AI-First-Strategie über alle Funktionen hinweg. Zudem haben wir Zugriff auf die Infrastruktur eines internationalen AdTech-Unternehmens mit über einer Billion ausgelieferter Werbeimpressionen pro Jahr.</p> <h2><strong>Die Rolle in einem Satz</strong></h2> <p>Du gewinnst neue regionale Werbekunden für VRM am Telefon, qualifizierst warme Leads und buchst hochwertige Termine für unsere Account Executives.</p> <h2><strong>Was du tust</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Telefonische Erstansprache regionaler Werbekunden auf Basis vorqualifizierter Leads</li> <li>Bedarfs- und Entscheiderqualifizierung im Erstgespräch</li> <li>Buchung qualifizierter Termine für die Account Executives im definierten Zielslot</li> <li>Saubere Übergabe inkl. Pain Points, Kontext und Entscheidungsstruktur</li> <li>Strukturierte Vorbereitung jedes Calls — Vorbereitung ist 80 % des Erfolgs</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Dein Setup</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Du arbeitest mit vorqualifizierten Leads — nicht mit Cold-Listen</li> <li>Salesforce als CRM, Aircall für die Telefonie, LLM-gestützte Recherche-Workflows</li> <li>Klares Sales-Playbook mit Pitch-, Einwand- und Übergabe-Logik</li> <li>Regelmäßige 1:1-Coachings, Call-Reviews und Pipeline-Calls</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Eigene Aktivitäts-Pipeline aufbauen, priorisieren und mit klaren KPIs (Calls/Tag, Termine/Tag, Show-Up-Rate) führen</li> <li>Recherche zu Kunden, Branchen und Standorten als Grundlage jedes Calls</li> <li>Pflege aller Aktivitäten und Opportunities in Salesforce</li> <li>Enge Abstimmung mit den Account Executives: Feedback zur Termin-Qualität, gemeinsame Iteration</li> <li>Aktives Mitwirken an der Weiterentwicklung von Pitches, Skripten und Workflows</li> </ul> <h2><strong>So ist die Rolle aufgesetzt</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Bericht direkt an den Head of Regional Sales</li> <li>Du arbeitest im Team mit anderen SDRs sowie eng mit den Account Executives, an die du übergibst</li> <li>Klare Karriereperspektive: Aufstieg zum Account Executive bei nachgewiesener Performance</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Dein Profil</strong></h2> <p>Diese Rolle ist bewusst auf Einsteiger und Quereinsteiger in den Sales zugeschnitten. Du passt, wenn du mindestens eines der folgenden Profile mitbringst:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Erste Sales-Erfahrung: </strong>Du hast in einer SDR-, BDR-, Inside-Sales-, Outbound-Call-Center- oder Telefonvertriebsrolle gearbeitet und willst auf das nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Quereinstieg mit Telefonaffinität: </strong>Du kommst aus Kundenservice, Retail, Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder einem anderen Umfeld mit viel Kundenkontakt und willst gezielt in den Sales wechseln.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Für beide Profile gilt:</p> <ul> <li>Du hast Spaß am Telefon, keine Scheu vor Erstansprache und kannst Menschen schnell für dich gewinnen</li> <li>Du arbeitest strukturiert, bereitest dich vor und nimmst KPIs ernst</li> <li>Du bist offen, coachable und willst täglich besser werden</li> <li>Du nutzt LLMs aktiv für Recherche und Vorbereitung, oder bist bereit, das schnell zu lernen</li> <li>Deutsch fließend auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (alle Calls auf Deutsch), Englisch von Vorteil</li> <li>Du willst nicht für immer SDR bleiben, der Aufstieg zum Account Executive ist dein Ziel</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Warum diese Rolle</strong></h2> <p>Du steigst nicht in eine fertige Vertriebsmaschine ein. Du baust eine neue Mediagattung im deutschen Markt mit auf — und legst damit die Pipeline-Grundlage für unser komplettes Regional-Sales-Geschäft.</p> <ul> <li>Echter Karrierepfad: Bei nachgewiesener Performance Aufstieg zum Account Executive in 12–18 Monaten</li> <li>Warme Leads statt Cold-Calling-Liste</li> <li>KI-gestützte Tools und Workflows, die deine Produktivität vervielfachen</li> <li>Strukturiertes Onboarding und kontinuierliches Coaching</li> <li>Attraktives Vergütungsmodell: Fixum + transparente Termin-Vergütung + ungedeckelte Commission<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Wenn du Sales lernen willst, wo es ernst gemeint ist und wo gute Leistung sichtbar wird, ist das die richtige Rolle.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Verve provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.&nbsp;<br><br>If you are a California resident subject to the California Consumer Privacy Act, <a href="https://verve.com/california-applicant-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">click here</a> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.<br></span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">If you are located in the EU or UK visit our&nbsp;</span><a style="font-size: 8pt;" href="https://verve.com/applicant-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a><span style="font-size: 8pt;"> to understand how Verve processes your personal information and how you can exercise your rights.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Agents
description: About Eye Security Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform. Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe. About this role We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our Agentic SOC team. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. This team's mission is to build LLM-powered agents that augment our security analysts, taking on repetitive investigation and triage work so humans can focus on the judgment-heavy parts of the job. You will work in a small, full-stack team of 2 to 3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets, and who is excited about shipping agents into a real production SOC where correctness, latency, and cost all matter. In this role Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production. You are trusted to take a high-level goal and turn it into a plan without close supervision. Lead the design and delivery of LLM agents that plug into our SOC workflows, including tool design, prompt and context engineering, evals, and guardrails. Make sound tradeoffs on accuracy, cost, latency, and how much autonomy to give the agent versus keeping a human in the loop. Drive technical design discussions in your stream and, where the work calls for it, influence architecture and standards beyond it. Set the bar for code quality, testing, and documentation on your team. Ground engineering decisions in outcomes. Push back when the "why" is unclear, propose simpler or faster paths to the business result, and stay close to the security analysts and customers your agents are meant to serve. Mentor engineers on your team and across the stream through pairing, code review, and design feedback. Act as a multiplier, not just a strong individual contributor. Participate in hiring: interview candidates, help shape the bar, and support onboarding. Contribute to a psychologically safe and outcome-oriented team culture. Lead by example in incidents and high-pressure moments. The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, with a commitment to travel to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week. What you will need 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently. Depth in at least one technical area and broad competence across the stack. You have designed and shipped systems where performance, security, reliability, and maintainability all mattered, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made. Experience with strongly typed languages (Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP, or similar). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our stack quickly. Hands-on experience building LLM agents, with evidence they were useful. You have built and shipped at least one non-trivial LLM-powered agent or agentic workflow, in production or as a side project with real users. You can speak concretely about the design choices you made around tool use, context and state, evals, failure handling, autonomy, cost, and latency and, just as importantly, what the agent changed for the people using it. Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow. A track record of raising the level of engineers around you through mentoring, code review, and design feedback. Strong communication skills. You can translate technical tradeoffs for engineers, product managers, and leadership, and you write designs and decisions in a way others can build on. Knowledge of secure coding practices and secure development principles to build safe, trusted systems. Fluency in English is a must. What we offer Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe. Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact. A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering and AI-augmented security operations: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice for both how we build and how our SOC operates. Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure. Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits. Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe. We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together. We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply! What You'll Bring 💡 Strategic content thinking. You approach content as a lever, not a deliverable. You ask what outcome a piece needs to drive before you write a word, and you're just as focused on distribution and measurement as you are on the writing itself. You're not here to fill a content calendar, you're here to shift how our market thinks about Almedia. C2-level B2B writing. You can take a complex product or technical concept and produce something a busy CMO would read in full. Long-form assets, white papers, case studies, product one-pagers, come out publish-ready, not draft-ready. You self-edit hard and don't need someone to rewrite your work. Story sourcing instinct. Build a product marketing toolkit for Freecash and Link, including messaging, one-pagers, pitch decks, and case studies, so that active deals and existing partnerships use the collateral instead of improvised slides. Track adoption and close the loop with the sales team on what's actually working.

raw.title: Product Owner, Technical - AI Investing
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly). API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching. AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation. Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress). DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments. Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives. Good to Have Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience. Certifications *:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering. Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments. Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting. Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery). Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles. Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems. description: Wir suchen Dich Vulcan Energie Ressourcen GmbH ist ein innovatives, schnell wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich nachhaltiger Lithiumgewinnung und erneuerbarer Energien. Für unser dynamisches und kreatives CSA Team am Standort Karlsruhe suchen wir dich in Vollzeit (40 h) als Senior Bauingenieur (m/w/d) für eine befristete Anstellung . Das erwartet Dich bei uns Du übernimmst eine führende Rolle bei der Definition, Umsetzung und Überwachung der CSA-Planungsanforderungen für Projekte und unterstützt die Koordination interner Teams sowie externer Engineering-Partner. Du stellst technische Exzellenz und die Anwendung bewährter Methoden bei der Umsetzung von Projektergebnissen sicher. Zudem unterstützt Du die Freigabe technischer Lösungen, einschließlich Standards und Abweichungen von Standards, und sorgst dafür, dass interne sowie von Auftragnehmern erstellte Ergebnisse den CSA- und Branchenstandards, Unternehmensrichtlinien und Projektspezifikationen entsprechen. Du arbeitest regelmäßig mit funktionsübergreifenden Fachbereichen, externen Lieferanten, Auftragnehmern und weiteren Projektbeteiligten zusammen. Dabei stellst Du die nahtlose Integration der CSA-Engineering-Komponenten sicher und förderst ein abgestimmtes Vorgehen. Du unterstützt die Projektbeschaffung, einschließlich der Einholung von Angeboten, Ausschreibungen, Bietergesprächen, Vertragsvergaben und Rechnungsprüfungen. Du hältst höchste Sicherheitsstandards ein. Während der Planungsphasen unterstützt Du ausgewogene Qualitätsentscheidungen, die den agilen Anforderungen eines Start-up-Umfelds Rechnung tragen. Du berichtest regelmäßig über den Projektstatus an den Lead CSA Engineer sowie das Delivery Management. Darüber hinaus stellst Du eine vollständige Dokumentation aller Engineering-Aktivitäten für Audits, Skalierbarkeit und Wissenstransfer sicher. Das solltest Du mitbringen Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss oder ein Diplom als Dipl.-Ing. bzw. Dipl.-Ing. (FH) im Bauingenieurwesen einer anerkannten internationalen Hochschule, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Verkehrsinfrastruktur, Wasserwirtschaft oder Rohrleitungsbau. Du bringst fundierte Berufserfahrung mit, vorzugsweise auf Senior-Level, und verfügst über umfassende Expertise im Anlagenbau, in der Kraftwerkstechnik, der CSA-Planung, im Pipelinebau, im Umgang mit Engineering-Software sowie bei der Fehleranalyse und der Bewertung projektspezifischer technischer Anforderungen. Außerdem kennst Du alle Leistungsphasen von der Planung über die Umsetzung bis hin zum Betrieb und verfügst über tiefgehende Kenntnisse der HOAI, VOB, DWA und TRGS. Du verfügst über nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office sowie relevanten Engineering-Softwarelösungen, beispielsweise AutoCAD 2D. Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und arbeitest erfolgreich mit internen Teams sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen. Zudem verfügst Du über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Du bist bereit, regelmäßig innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um mit internationalen Teams, Kunden und Projektstandorten zusammenzuarbeiten. Du interessierst Dich für erneuerbare Energien und bringst die Motivation mit, innovative Lösungen in diesem Zukunftsbereich zu entwickeln und umzusetzen. Du verfügst über eine ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und schaffst es, Zusammenarbeit, Zusammenhalt und ein positives Arbeitsumfeld innerhalb Deines Teams zu fördern. So trägst Du zu einer effizienten und erfolgreichen Projektumsetzung bei. Du verstehst es, technische Inhalte verständlich zu vermitteln, und schlägst die Brücke zwischen technischem Know-how und dessen praktischer Umsetzung. Dabei kommunizierst Du klar und zielgerichtet mit Teammitgliedern, Stakeholdern und Kunden, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich. raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d): AI-Native Development
raw.description:
Job Description

We protect our customers’ digital infrastructure, keeping it secure, fast, and online, even under active attack. As a cybersecurity provider, we run high-performance systems in a genuinely hostile environment, where code quality, security, and rigorous input validation are not hygiene: they are the product. Our customers trust us with business-critical traffic, and we build and operate to the highest standards of certification for critical infrastructure.

As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d), you will help your team design and build robust solutions for complex problems. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, who starts from the problem, reasons about the trade-offs of the environment it will run in, and reaches for the tool that fits, rather than the one on their CV. We are constantly improving our applications and we work AI-natively: AI coding agents are part of how we spec, build, and review every day. We strongly believe in “you build it, you run it, you own it” and a “collaboration culture”, where you and the team are on the frontlines and driving the change together!


Your Responsibilities

  • Own features end-to-end, from backend service design through to the frontend slice the feature needs, in an international, cross-functional team of software engineers, QA and OPS professionals
  • Design, validate and advocate architecture decisions for your team’s verticals, with a bias toward well-structured, service-oriented backends
  • Work AI-natively: use AI coding agents as core tooling to move faster and raise quality, while staying fully accountable for the code you ship
  • Drive technical discussions and decisions with your team
  • Push toward continuous delivery, improving both the software and how we build it
  • Write code that performs, and holds up in production under hostile, high-volume traffic, with security and input validation built in from the start


Your Qualifications

  • You think in systems. You start from the problem and the constraints, not from a favorite language. To you the difference between languages is largely syntax; what actually matters is the environment code runs in: performance, portability, compatibility, operational cost, and long-term maintenance
  • You can explain your choices. You can walk us through a time you chose one language or runtime over another, and the trade-offs that drove the decision, and you can do the same for the frontend when a feature calls for it
  • You’ve gone deep, not just broad. At least 5 years of intensive, hands-on coding and engineering experience — this is a senior role and not a fit for juniors — with genuine depth in at least one or two ecosystems. Our stack today is mostly PHP / Symfony, React and GraphQL; Edge systems use C, Rust and Python mostly. 
  • We care a lot about experience with Python, Go, C and/or Rust. These are parts that are being introduced to our dev department and where a significant part of our edge logic is based in, and someone who already reasons and builds fluently in them will make an outsized difference; this is a real signal for us, not a nice-to-have footnote
  • Security and code quality are instincts, not afterthoughts. You write code that holds up under hostile, high-volume traffic; you treat every input as untrusted, validate rigorously, and understand how a weak boundary or a hot-path regression becomes an attack surface. Reliability under load is a first-class concern for you
  • You’re fluent with AI-assisted development. You treat AI coding agents as core tooling; you know their strengths and limits, and you own the outcome (including reviewing AI-written code for exactly the security and validation gaps above)
  • You reason comfortably about the whole picture: APIs, services, data, and the frontend the feature owns; you don’t stop at a language boundary
  • You're at home on Linux systems, and CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and deployment considerations are a natural part of how you think about shipping software, not foreign territory
  • Curious by default; you like to validate ideas hands-on with POCs and RFCs
  • At home in an agile team with structured requirements, and quick to learn
  • You speak and write English fluently

You'll work on challenging applied ML problems where model quality, product decisions and customer experience are tightly connected. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code. This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it. What You'll Own Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself. Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools. Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data. Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system. Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize. Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable. First 90 Days One way the first 90 could unfold. Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Embed with a first customer, learn their workflow, and define the real problem. Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Build and deploy a production system they actually use. Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Spot the pattern worth productizing and work with R&D to turn it into platform. What You Bring 2+ years of professional software engineering, with software shipped end to end. Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar). Ability to work across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems quickly. Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. Willingness to travel to client sites as needed. Nice to Have A track record of shipping real systems with real users, not just assigned tasks. High agency and strong prioritization: you find the core problem and move. Comfort defining your own path when there isn't one. Evidence of working directly with customers and translating what you heard into what you built. Clear communication, including explaining a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder. Luma's mission is to build unified general intelligence that can generate, understand, and operate in the physical world. We believe multimodality is critical for intelligence — the next step beyond language models comes from vision. Luma is an equal opportunity employer. You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role. place</li> <li>You use AI as part of how you actually work, and you have built things with it that other people went on to use, not demos you gave once</li> <li>You communicate complicated things anyone used it, and act on the answer</li> <li>Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Need to Be about APIs, data pipelines and system boundaries, and to be an equal partner in an engineering discussion</li> <li>Experience building for a hierarchy of users who need different things from the same your own data questions</li> <li>Fluency in the analytics and BI tooling landscape, and a view on what makes a dashboard worth returning to rather than merely correct</li> <li>Demonstrated ownership of a product roadmap end to end, from problem definition through to something shipped and adopted</li> <li>A track record of getting things done across teams, and the communication to influence engineering and commercial partners</li> <li>Experience working directly with enterprise customers, including holding a position they disagree with</li> <li>Comfortable operating remote-first, across a distributed team</li> <li>Willingness to travel occasionally for store and customer visits</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Would Set You Apart</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in working with high-volume, noisy sensor or computer-vision data</li> <li>Experience with change data capture into a cloud warehouse (ideally Snowflake)</li> <li>Experience shipping AI-powered features, including the call on when a model is good enough to ship</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why Focal Systems<br></strong></p> <p>Joining Focal Systems means becoming part of a company that's truly making a difference in the retail world. Program using R, Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) or similar analytical languages.&nbsp;<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Perform data engineering, data processing and modeling techniques using cloud-based data management, data science, and ML platforms such as Databricks, IBM Cloud Pak, Cloudera, and Snowflake.<br>• &nbsp; &nbsp;Communicate complex concepts and hypothesis to a non-technical audience through digital storytelling.</p> </div> <div><strong>Requirements</strong></div> <ul> <li>A minimum of 1 year of hands-on Data Science experience is required.</li> <li>Bachelor's Degree in a STEM field is required.</li> <li>Proficient with one or more programming languages (Java, C++, Python, R, etc.)</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to apply data science to solve real-world problems</li> <li>Secret Clearance</li> </ul> <div><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></div> <div> <ul> <li>Familiarity with DoD</li> <li>Master’s degree in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, or related fields.&nbsp;</li> <li>Familiarity with Envision</li> <li>Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility</li> </ul> <p>Salary Range: $97,000 - $233,000</p> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <div class="p-rich_text_section">We are an equal opportunity employer.   • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

description: About Docker Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout. We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default. _______________________________________________________________________ Docker's partner ecosystem, spanning technology partners, GSIs, ISVs, resellers, distributors, and cloud alliances, is how Docker extends its reach into enterprise accounts beyond direct sales coverage. Docker is investing meaningfully in this ecosystem, and the Manager, Global Partner Marketing owns the marketing function that powers it. As Docker enters its next stage of growth, this is a role for a builder: someone ready to evolve partner marketing from a set of discrete activities into a comprehensive, end-to-end strategy, integrated with Docker's broader GTM and marketing motions and aligned with our partner ecosystem goals. You will define how Docker shows up for its partners globally, from portal governance and MDF strategy to co-marketing campaigns, events, and the sales-ready assets that equip partners to win in market. You will set the function's strategy, standards, and operating model, and build the roadmap and team that scale with the business. You will operate as the marketing counterpart to senior ecosystem leadership, including the VP of Partnerships and Alliances and the broader Global Alliances team: setting the partner marketing agenda, driving global initiatives that accelerate ecosystem growth, and representing partner marketing in Docker's marketing and alliances leadership forums. You will also partner closely with the Strategic Partner Program Director to bring the partner program to life, ensuring every element is supported with the right content, campaigns, and tools. The role reports to the Sr. Director, Growth Marketing. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Partner marketing at Docker is a measurable contributor to revenue growth. The strategy you set carries pipeline targets, the MDF budget you own carries ROI reporting, and the portal you govern shows adoption and engagement trending up. Your work spans three motions: marketing to partners, keeping them engaged, informed, and enabled; marketing through partners, equipping them to carry Docker into their markets; and marketing with partners, co-marketing that generates pipeline for both sides. You operate at every altitude, internally and externally: with senior leaders, with partners in region, and with the execution-level stakeholders across marketing, the partner organization, product, and other cross-functional teams who ship the work alongside you. Your decisions are grounded in data. And you do not just stay close to the work, you do the work: this function starts with you as both its builder and its operator. Your collaboration with field marketing across EMEA, Americas, and APAC will be critical to keeping partner marketing globally consistent and locally relevant, and over time you build what lasts: the processes, standards, operating model, and eventually the team that let partner marketing scale beyond any one person. RESPONSIBILITIES Strategy & Function Leadership Own and lead Docker's global partner marketing function: strategy, budget, standards, and operating model, including the structure, resourcing, and team the function needs as Docker's ecosystem scales. Build and maintain the annual Global Partner Marketing Plan, defining spend allocation, pipeline targets, and the marketing motions that support partner-led growth across all tiers and geographies. Serve as the marketing counterpart to alliances leadership: shape ecosystem GTM strategy with the VP of Partnerships and Alliances, carry credibility with senior partner executives, and own quarterly planning and reporting on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, MDF ROI, and portal adoption. Partner Campaigns & Pipeline Translate partner program requirements into scalable campaigns and marketing motions that partners can execute independently or co-execute with Docker, and own the partner marketing calendar in sync with corporate marketing, product launches, and field marketing. Operationalize partner lead management with the Strategic Partner Program Director and Partner Operations, driving joint demand generation programs that produce qualified leads and tracking the partner pipeline they create. Partner Communications, Portal & Content Lead all partner-facing communications on a cadence that keeps partners engaged, informed, and enabled, with the Partner Portal as a key channel. Lead Partner Portal (PRM) governance and optimization with the Strategic Partner Program Director, keeping content current and well-organized across tiers and partner types, and driving engagement and adoption. Own partner-facing messaging and content: Docker's partner web presence, the value story for each partner segment, and a comprehensive asset library that equips partners to sell Docker in market. Partner MDF & Co-Marketing Own the global Partner MDF program end to end, from program design and eligibility through approval, activity tracking, compliance, and ROI reporting. Develop MDF-funded co-marketing plans with partners that drive pipeline and brand awareness on both sides. Partner Events & Webinars Set Docker's partner event strategy and execute it with Field Marketing, the Events team, and local partner teams: partner summits, partner tracks at DockerCon and industry events, webinars, and roadshows. Ensure every activation carries a follow-up motion that converts engagement into pipeline. QUALIFICATIONS 8+ years in partner, channel, or ecosystem marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or open-source software, with a proven track record of building and scaling global partner marketing programs and the pipeline results to show for it. Leadership experience: you have led a function, managed or mentored marketers, or operated as the senior-most partner marketing voice in an organization, and you are ready to build and lead a team as the function scales. Hands-on command of the partner marketing toolkit: PRM platforms, MDF programs and co-marketing budgets with ROI reporting, and the core marketing stack (Salesforce, Marketo or HubSpot, Asana or similar). Data-driven operator: comfortable with pipeline reporting, MDF ROI analysis, and portal engagement metrics, and able to run multiple workstreams across time zones. Executive-level communication and collaboration: you can set an agenda with a VP, write for partners and developers, defend a budget with data, and build trust with senior stakeholders inside and outside the company. A global mindset, attuned to regional nuances across EMEA, Americas, and APAC, and a builder mentality: energized by creating the strategy, processes, and team from the ground up. Familiarity with developer tools, container technology, or cloud-native ecosystems is a strong advantage. WHAT TO EXPECT This role starts in execution. There are partner-facing moments already on the calendar in your first quarter that you will help land while you build the function underneath them. First 30 Days Immerse in Docker's product, partner ecosystem, and program structure, and align with Growth Marketing leadership, the VP of Partnerships and Alliances, the Global Alliances team, and the Strategic Partner Program Director on priorities and the near-term moments the ecosystem team is counting on. Audit the current state across partner assets, portal content, communications, MDF, and in-flight co-marketing, and connect with field marketing across EMEA, Americas, and APAC plus Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Corporate Communications. Form a first view on what the function needs to scale: budget, resourcing, and operating model. First 90 Days Land the in-flight partner marketing moments of the quarter: communications, webinars, event presence, and the supporting assets partners need, delivered on time and on message. Stand up the foundations: a partner communication cadence partners can rely on, portal governance with refreshed content across tiers and partner types, and an operational MDF program with its first ROI baseline. Ship the annual Global Partner Marketing Plan, covering spend allocation, pipeline targets, and priority activities by tier and geography, with a resourcing roadmap attached, and establish the leadership review cadence with Growth Marketing and Alliances. One Year Outlook Partner marketing is a measurable contributor to Docker's revenue growth, with clean attribution on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and a reporting rhythm leadership trusts. The foundations run at target: the portal is the trusted home for partner content, the MDF program funds the co-marketing that works, the asset library is live and actively used by partners, and the events engine converts engagement into pipeline. The function has a clear strategy, operating model, and resourcing plan, with the team taking shape as it scales. Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role. Compensation & Equity EU: €95,900 – €137,000 + equity United States: $147,000– $210,000 + equity ______________________________________________________________________ Posting Information Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role. AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process. Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent. ______________________________________________________________________ Perks & Benefits Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration. Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work. Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break. Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success. Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work. Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning. Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment. Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow. Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country. Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old. Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior Electronics Engineer (RF Focus)
description: <h2>Introduction</h2> <p>We are looking for an RF Electronics Engineer to join our world-class multidisciplinary team and help solve complex technical challenges across a wide range of industries.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>At Cambridge Consultants, we help our clients develop breakthrough technologies across industries including Energy and Industrial, Defence and Security, Consumer, Telecoms, Healthcare and Biotechnology, and many others.</p> <p>As an Electronics Engineer with an RF focus, you will work within multidisciplinary project teams to solve challenging technical problems for clients ranging from ambitious start-ups to global organisations and government bodies. You'll take ownership of the electronics elements of projects, contributing both broad electronics expertise and specialist RF knowledge.</p> <p>We're interested in hearing from engineers at different stages of their careers, from those building on an existing RF specialism through to experienced RF engineers looking to apply their expertise to a wider variety of technical challenges. We'll shape the role around the skills, experience and impact you bring.</p> <p>We're less concerned with experience of specific software packages than with a strong track record of solving RF and electronics challenges. However, candidates may have experience with tools such as CST, HFSS, Microwave Office, and Altium PCB design, and we'd welcome exposure to any of these areas, even if not all of them.</p> <p>This role is well suited to engineers who enjoy tackling unfamiliar problems, working closely with clients and multidisciplinary teams, and taking ownership of delivering robust, real-world solutions. As your career develops, you'll have opportunities to deepen your technical expertise, broaden your responsibilities, and contribute to the growth of new client opportunities.</p> <h3>What will you be doing?</h3> <p>Some interesting electronics challenges that we’ve previously solved include:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.wired.com/video/watch/an-inside-look-at-legos-new-tech-packed-smart-brick">Collaborating with LEGO</a> to develop <a href="https://www.wired.com/story/exclusive-inside-look-at-new-lego-smart-brick/">LEGO® SMART Play™</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/low-power-high-performance-smart-wearable-for-accesso/">Design of a low-power, high-performance smart wearable for Accesso</a> integrating multiple radios</li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/case-studies/wireless-breakthrough-ocado-smart-platform">Developing a novel air-interface and bespoke communication systems for the Ocado Smart Platform controlling hundreds of robots in grocery distribution centres</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/case-studies/iridium-extreme-satellite-phone">Developing the Iridium Extreme satellite phone, the first truly-global ‘push-to-talk’ mobile communications system</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/next-generation-explosive-ordnance-disposal-for-the-british-army/">Next-generation Explosive Ordnance Disposal for the British Army</a></li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/project/the-worlds-largest-commercial-airborne-antenna-for-spl/">High altitude 5G phased array for targeted cellular coverage, with internal data-rates of over 10&nbsp;Tbps</a></li> <li>Multiple high-performance custom electronics developments for Defence and Security applications</li> </ul> <p>Every project we undertake is different. We are typically creating something new rather than refining an existing solution, so you can expect a steady stream of technically diverse and intellectually stimulating challenges.</p> <p>You'll also have access to our extensive in-house facilities, which support every stage of hardware development engineering. These include:</p> <ul> <li>Prototype PCB manufacturing facilities, including SMT pick-and-place, vapour-phase reflow and X-ray inspection</li> <li>EMC emissions test facility</li> <li><a href="https://www.cambridgeconsultants.com/wp-content/images/internal/2024_Antenna-Research-Centre_Sales-sheet_HTML/index.html">5GHz 360° antenna test facility</a></li> </ul> <h3>What can you bring?</h3> <p>We are looking for engineers with commercial electronics experience and a passion for developing innovative technology. We are open to candidates with varying levels of experience and will tailor the role and level accordingly based on the expertise and capability demonstrated during the recruitment process.</p> <p>This is a client-facing role, so strong communication skills, curiosity, and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams are essential.</p> <p>Essential technical requirements:</p> <ul> <li>Strong academic background with an electronics-related undergraduate degree</li> <li>Solid understanding of the fundamentals of electronic circuit design</li> <li>Specialist RF electronics design experience, such as RF LNAs, RF Power Amplifiers and associated circuits</li> <li>Experience of low-noise DC switched-mode power-supply (SMPS) design</li> <li>Hands-on experience of bringing up, debugging and testing hardware designs using equipment such as vector network analysers (VNAs), spectrum analysers and signal generators</li> </ul> <p>Engineers who thrive in this role are comfortable taking ownership of technical work, learning quickly when faced with new challenges, and applying sound engineering judgement to deliver robust solutions in a client-focused environment.</p> <p>Due to the nature of some of our key projects, you<strong> must be eligible for UK security clearance</strong> to be considered for this role.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p style="text-align: center;"><strong>By submitting an application to Cambridge Consultants, you confirm that the information provided in this application, together with any supporting documentation, is true, complete, and accurate to the best of your knowledge and belief. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on the data infrastructure that powers our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the systems that make world-class data possible. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

 

  • Building large-scale data pipelines for collecting, processing, filtering, and transforming datasets used to train state-of-the-art models.

  • Training models used in our data processing pipelines, such as classifiers, quality filters, and labeling models.

  • Designing data curation strategies such as deduplication, quality scoring, labeling, and augmentation that measurably improve model performance.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers explore and train on massive datasets quickly and reliably.

 

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

 

  • Experience building data-intensive systems, ideally in support of machine learning training pipelines.

  • Strong engineering skills in distributed data processing at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, or custom pipelines over large datasets).

  • The capacity to autonomously evaluate how data quality, composition, and curation affect model outcomes, and to build the tooling to measure it.

 

Bonus: Experience building or operating web crawlers.

 

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

 

#LI-Remote

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on deploying and optimizing our frontier AI models in production. The quality of our models only matters if they can be served fast, reliably, and at scale. You will own the systems that turn research breakthroughs into real-time products used by millions. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:

  • Deploying state-of-the-art models to production and owning the path from research checkpoint to serving infrastructure.

  • Optimizing inference performance across the stack, including latency, throughput, and cost, using techniques such as quantization, distillation, KV-cache optimization, batching strategies, and custom kernels.

  • Building and tuning high-performance serving systems for real-time, streaming workloads where every millisecond matters.

  • Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers ship new models to production quickly, safely, and with confidence in their performance characteristics.

Requirements

We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:

  • Experience deploying and serving ML models in production, ideally for latency-sensitive or real-time applications.

  • The capacity to autonomously profile, diagnose, and eliminate bottlenecks across the serving stack, from model architecture to kernels to orchestration, and to build the tooling to measure it.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order. What You'll Be Doing You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app. Here's what your day-to-day might look like: Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products. Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why. Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order. Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest: Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant. You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them. You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now. You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions. You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own. You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next. You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all). You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype. Next steps The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us! Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
